I saved the draft mail to Hollis and let Anselm know in your DM. Nothing has been sent yet; someone still has to send the draft.

- **Draft:** it's addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate, credits Marcus as the source and says Anselm approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis to check with Anselm or June before passing the rate on.
- **Approval:** a per-seat rate is a finance figure, and Hollis isn't on the list of people who can see those by default. Anselm, as CFO, is one of the two people who can approve that, and he did so in this message. So I didn't open a separate approval request. The address is internal, so Ruth's approval for outside mail didn't apply.
- **The figure:** I took the $2,101 from Anselm's message. A search of the knowledge base found nothing on the Thornbury rate, so I couldn't check it against Marcus's original. Nothing I found contradicts it either.
